name: waggle-os
description: Waggle OS — workspace-native AI agent platform with persistent memory

scripts.build: cd apps/web && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && npx vite build --outDir ../../dist --emptyOutDir
scripts.build:dev: cd apps/web && npx vite build --mode development --outDir ../../dist --emptyOutDir
scripts.build:packages: cd packages/shared && npx tsc --build && cd ../waggle-dance && npx tsc --build --force && cd ../hive-mind-core && npx tsc --build && cd ../core && npx tsc --build && cd ../weaver && npx tsc --build && cd ../wiki-compiler && npx tsc --build && cd ../marketplace && npx tsc --build && cd ../agent && npx tsc --build && cd ../server && npx tsc --build && cd ../worker && npm run build
scripts.build:all: npm run build:packages && npm run build

author: Marko Markovic
//devDependencies: The five eslint entries are what `eslint.config.js` imports directly. They are declared here because the root lint gate (`npm run lint`, ci.yml) must own its own dependencies: until 2026-09-19 they were only resolved by npm hoisting them out of apps/web, so bumping apps/web's eslint to 10 nested that whole subtree and the gate died with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND on 'globals'. Root stays on eslint 9 — eslint-plugin-react-hooks@5 peers <=9; apps/web runs eslint 10 against its own config. @playwright/test is here for the same reason: the ROOT owns the Playwright suite (playwright.config.ts, playwright-e2e.config.ts, tests/e2e, tests/visual), but the test:e2e* scripts ran node_modules/playwright/cli.js, a package nothing declared - it reached the root only as a transitive dependency of apps/web's @playwright/test. The scripts now use @playwright/test's own CLI, and the range matches apps/web so npm keeps one copy: @playwright/test pins playwright to an EXACT version, so declaring playwright separately would risk a second. See TD-DEP-1.
//optionalDependencies: Platform-specific native binaries — optional so npm SKIPS them on os/cpu mismatch (Linux/macOS CI) instead of failing install with EBADPLATFORM. See docs/audits/2026-06-01-full-repo-verification-sweep.md.
